title: Some Devaswom officials involved in ghee scam, claims Keralam Minister Muraleedharan
description: The Vigilance and Anti-Corruption Bureau’s Special Investigation Unit recently arrested a transport contractor for allegedly diverting 11,000 litres of Milma ghee meant for the Sabarimala temple and replacing it with a cheaper product, causing an estimated loss of ₹2.5 crore to the TDB
